evals.prompt: I made this layout in kle-ng (attached as layout.json, it's an Alice-style board with rotated halves). I have a Waveshare RP2040-Zero. Which pins do I solder each row and column to, and which way do the diodes go?
evals.expected_output: Matrix fits in 20 edge pins (or explains the overflow), avoids GP16, gives a per-row/column pin table and says the diode stripe faces the row wire for COL2ROW.

evals.prompt: building a wired split 5x6 per side with two pro micros and a trrs cable. give me the keyboard.json for qmk and tell me how to wire the jack. also how do i make the right side know it's the right side
evals.expected_output: keyboard.json with 5 row pins per half, split.enabled, bitbang serial on D0-D3 (not also used in matrix), TRS/TRRS wiring VCC/GND/data identical on both halves, warning not to hot-plug TRRS, handedness options (EE_HANDS/MASTER_LEFT/SPLIT_HAND_PIN).

evals.prompt: Converting my corne to wireless with two nice!nanos and 110mAh batteries. Can I keep using Vial? How do I wire the battery and power switch, and roughly how long will it last with the OLEDs on?
evals.expected_output: States nice!nano is ZMK-only (no Vial; suggests ZMK Studio/keymap editing instead), battery + through switch to B+, check JST polarity, 100 mA charge OK for 110 mAh, central half drains faster, OLEDs cut battery life substantially, ZMK sleep/ext-power settings.
